top_issues.issue: Long draft composer shows clipped glyph fragments at the top edge and a stray scrollbar stub beside the attach icon; no caret visible.
top_issues.evidence: Descender fragments of the previous line at y≈557 (composer top border at 553); scrollbar thumb 4x14pt at x≈1180,y≈738-752 next to the paperclip at x=1207.
top_issues.fix: Clip text to the inner padding rect (12pt inset) and add a 16pt fade at the top; give the text area its own scrollbar column 8pt wide on the right, full height of the text area, above the action row; draw the caret (2pt, accent colour) whenever focused.

top_issues.issue: Call bar duplicates the meeting title, has no leave/hang-up or duration, and the 'Restore' and 'Close bar' labels are ambiguous; the 'Meeting ended' line attaches to the preceding message.
top_issues.evidence: 'Design review: Wren 0.2' at y=19 and again at y=112 in a 380pt panel; 'Meeting ended: 58 min · 11:12' sits 4pt below Alex's text, while messages are 20pt apart.
top_issues.fix: Merge into one header: title plus 'In meeting · 12:04' timer on one row, actions as icon+label 'Phone', 'Back to Wren', 'Leave' (Leave in danger red #c42b2b / #f27474). Give system lines 16pt above and below, matching date dividers.

top_issues.issue: Text fields don't show focus. Only the composer gets the 2pt accent ring, so a field that is being typed in looks idle.
top_issues.evidence: Filter with 'zz' and New chat field with 'ra' both have 1pt #8a8d95 (dark #6e7179), the same as idle; composer focused is 2pt #a9530f / #e88c3e.
top_issues.fix: Apply the composer focus style to every text input: 2pt #a9530f (dark #e88c3e) border, or a 1pt border plus a 2pt 30% accent outer ring, and always draw the caret.

top_issues.issue: Pending-image thumbnails are centre-cropped, so wide or tall images are misrepresented, and remove buttons cover the image corners.
top_issues.evidence: 3072x256 thumbnail shows about 1.5 of 12 birds; 256x3072 shows fragments; the x buttons sit inside the image at its top-right.
top_issues.fix: Letterbox with 'contain' on a #eeeef0 / #2c2d33 tile (144x96pt), keep the dimension caption, and place the remove button half outside the tile corner (20pt circle, 1pt border #dfdfe3 / #303137).

top_issues.issue: At 760pt width the list pane keeps its full 232pt; names truncate heavily and the conversation gets only 464pt.
top_issues.evidence: 'Katherine Jo…', 'Design rev…', 'Grace Hop…' in chats; 'Katherine …', 'Ada Lovela…' in calls, where call and video buttons take 76pt of every row.
top_issues.fix: Below 900pt shrink the list to 200pt and drop the avatar to 32pt; in Calls show the call and video buttons only on hover or selection, so names get the full width.

top_issues.issue: The accent orange is overloaded and dilutes hierarchy: own author name, unread times, unread dots, mentions, selection bars, focus rings, primary buttons and the DEMO label all share #a9530f / #e88c3e.
top_issues.evidence: Up to 9 orange elements in chats.png at once; own name 'Alex Rivera' #a9530f reads like a mention or alert.
top_issues.fix: Render the person's own author name in the normal text colour #1b1c1f / #e9e9ec at semibold; keep orange for unread, mention and primary actions only; render DEMO as an 11pt neutral pill (#4a4d55 text on #e4e4e8).

top_issues.issue: Control heights are inconsistent: the meeting-link Join button is 32pt beside a 28pt input; header buttons are 28pt while dialog buttons are 32pt; the New chat input is 33pt.
top_issues.evidence: calls input y=125-152 (28pt) vs Join y=125-156 (32pt); calendar Copy link/Join 28pt; status dialog buttons 32pt; new-chat input 33pt.
top_issues.fix: Use one control height per density: 28pt for inline controls (inputs and the buttons next to them), 32pt for dialog footers. Make the Calls input and Join both 32pt and vertically centre them.

top_issues.issue: Primary buttons draw a 1pt grey outline around the orange fill, giving them a muddy edge.
top_issues.evidence: first-sync-empty New chat: edge pixel #8a8d95 then fill #a9530f (dark #6e7179 then #e88c3e).
top_issues.fix: Make the primary border the fill colour, or a 1pt darker accent: #8f450c in light, #d07a30 in dark.

top_issues.issue: Meeting detail is thin and poorly composed: a 640pt left-aligned card in a 916pt pane, actions far away in the header, redundant rows, no attendees.
top_issues.evidence: Card x=388-1028; Join at x=1199-1264; 'Location: Teams' duplicates 'Online: Microsoft Teams meeting'.
top_issues.fix: Put Join and Copy link directly under the title inside the content column; drop the Location row when it equals Teams; add an attendee row with 24pt avatars and RSVP state; cap the column at 720pt and centre it like the chat column.

top_issues.issue: Pane and surface separation relies on near-identical backgrounds; cards and dividers sit at about 1.3:1.
top_issues.evidence: List #f6f6f7 vs main #ffffff = 1.08:1 (dark #1d1e22 vs #17181b = 1.07:1) with no divider; card border #dfdfe3 on white = 1.33:1; message hover #f6f6f7 = 1.08:1.
top_issues.fix: Add a 1pt #dfdfe3 / #303137 divider between list and main pane; raise the hover tint to #f0f0f2 (light) and #222328 (dark).

top_issues.issue: Switcher results are cut at 8 rows with no scroll cue, no divider before the hint footer, and no result type.
top_issues.evidence: Last row 'Margaret Hamilton' ends at y≈585; hints at y=603-631 with no separator.
top_issues.fix: Add a 1pt #dfdfe3 / #303137 divider above the footer, a bottom fade when more rows exist, and a right-aligned 11pt type label (Chat, Meeting, Channel) in #62656d.

top_issues.issue: Every thread has a full outlined Reply button, which repeats heavy chrome; the hover toolbar collides with the clipped author row at narrow width.
top_issues.evidence: Three 72x28pt outlined Reply buttons in one view; channel-narrow toolbar y=56-90 over the author row at y=60-75.
top_issues.fix: Make Reply a 12pt text link with icon (#4a4d55, no border) inside the thread card's footer; clamp the hover toolbar so it never overlaps the header (min y = header bottom + 8pt).

top_issues.issue: The Settings scrollbar is heavy and the theme selector is three separate pills.
top_issues.evidence: Scrollbar thumb 6pt #8a8d95 on white at x=886-893; System/Light/Dark pills have separate borders 8pt apart.
top_issues.fix: Use a 4pt thumb in #c4c5c9 / #494b51 that widens on hover; render theme as one segmented control 28pt tall with a shared border.

top_issues.issue: The sign-in flow shifts layout between steps as the card height changes, and the hover tooltip runs past the card.
top_issues.evidence: Footer y = 630, 553, 628, 477, 632, 596 across states; tooltip spans x=609-1118 against a card ending at x=874.
top_issues.fix: Give the card a 240pt minimum height and pin the footer to the window bottom (24pt margin); wrap tooltips at 320pt.

top_issues.issue: Presence badges for Away, Be right back and Offline are near-identical 10pt rings.
top_issues.evidence: Away is a brown ring #8a5a00 with a hollow centre, BRB a #8a5a00 clock, Offline a grey ring #a1a3a9; all about 10pt.
top_issues.fix: Use 12pt badges with distinct glyphs (Away: filled #c38a00 with a clock; BRB: arrow; Offline: grey ring with an x) and a 2pt background-coloured cutout.

top_issues.issue: The status field placeholder is close in tone to the dialog's body text, and there is no expiry option.
top_issues.evidence: Placeholder #9c9ea8 vs helper text #b4b6bf (1.3:1 apart) on #25262b/#17181b.
top_issues.fix: Italicise or lighten the placeholder to #7c7f88 (still 4.5:1 on #17181b), and add a 'Clear after' select (Never, 1 hour, Today, This week).
